subject.title: [Bug]: Unscheduled reminder guard fires for isolated-session crons + counter lost during compaction

question: Should maintainers adopt or refresh the open fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/473, or open a target-repo replacement for the same source-proven fix?
rationale: The fix shape is clear, but an exact closing PR exists outside the target repository and is conflicting without maintainer push access, so automation should not queue a duplicate fix without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt Or Replace The Focused Fix
options.body: Use the fork PR as source material or open a narrow target-repo replacement with isolated-cron and compaction-counter regression coverage.

options.title: Wait On The Fork PR
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and wait for the contributor to refresh it into a mergeable, maintainer-modifiable path.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Reminder Cleanup
options.body: Defer this exact bug behind broader reminder-guard work, accepting that the current isolated-cron false positive remains open meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Adopt Or Replace The Focused Fix
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR as source material or open a narrow target-repo replacement with isolated-cron and compaction-counter regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They committed the prior active-cron suppression and extracted the current guard helper, making them the best available owner for the adopt-or-replace choice.
